Variants.Content: Toulouse embodied the soul of Occitan civilization beside the Garonne. Rebuilding from Albigensian crusade ravages, its Capitoul magistrates defended municipal liberties while Saint Sernin basilica welcomed streams of Compostela pilgrims.
Founded to combat Cathar theology, the University of Toulouse trained Dominican inquisitors and jurists to anchor orthodoxy.
